title: Store Receiving Standard: Where the Damage Arose and the Allowance on Delivered Ridgeline Special Order Services Orders
content:
On a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order, damage on an item delivered to the customer's address carries a delivery-damage multiplier on the damage allowance, set by what the store receipt inspection recorded.

**Clause.** The delivery-damage multiplier depends on where the damage arose: an order delivered to the customer's address whose store receipt inspection recorded good gives a multiplier of 1.2; an order delivered to the customer's address with no store receipt inspection on record gives 1.1; otherwise the delivery-damage multiplier is 1.

The damage allowance is multiplied by the delivery-damage multiplier in the same product as the delivered price and the percentage at which the allowance is figured, before that product is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Records read

- The order's fulfilment method: delivered to the customer's address (home delivery), store pickup, or installer job site.
- The store receipt inspections on the order and the condition each recorded.

## Multiplier by record

| Fulfilment | Store receipt inspection on the order | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| home delivery | at least one recorded good | 1.2 |
| home delivery | none on record | 1.1 |
| home delivery | on record, none recorded good | 1 |
| store pickup or installer job site | any | 1 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical delivered price 2479.00 at 10 percent)

| Store receipt record | Product | Product rounded to the cent |
|---|---|---|
| good | 2479.00 by 0.10 by 1.2 | 297.48 |
| none | 2479.00 by 0.10 by 1.1 | 272.69 |
